profile.headline: Software Engineer, AI Storage
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Storage Service for AI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Storage Service for AI
Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Updated speech services to support HIPAA compliance, adding new API options and supporting encryption of sensitive data
- Cut AWS CloudWatch costs by over $8,000 a month by implementing a logging pipeline with Logstash and Filebeat using AWS ECS
- Supported speech microservices, improving transient error handling, increasing integration testing, and managing infrastructure with Terraform
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Jenkins · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon ECS · Docker · C#

positions.title: Data Science Platform Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Designed a dockerized python microservice utilizing Kafka and Tensorflow to allow efficient, scalable neural network condition predictions, making over 160 predictions per second
◦ Led a rearchitecture of the core multithreaded data processing pipeline to allow for horizontal scaling and asynchronous processing of intensive inference workloads
◦ Served as primary dev and on-call for the Iodine engine processing over 2 billion messages a day
◦ Built a fully custom web-app for building machine learning models to assist in the process of defining features and network structures, fetching and de-identifying relevant input data, and training in AWS
◦ Discovered an inefficiency in document-based ML predictions, doubling prediction performance
◦ Designed a new processing system to reduce latency and maintain SLOs by batching work, resulting in 56% less processing time

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
◦ Implemented bus controller classes in C++ as part of team project developing a data bus system for B2 Bomber mission simulation software
◦ Configured linux development environments and managed git branching and merging to improve
performance for other team members

positions.title: Enterprise Resource Planning Technical Support Intern
positions.description:
▪ Updated and sent a daily energy report of North American oil and gas prices to over 80 employees for on-site consumption adjustments and generator controls at Invista plants
▪ Wrote Python scripts utilizing the Pandas library to convert large data reports managing PO and Invoice data
▪ Met with the procurement team to identify and implement improvements to Microsoft Sharepoint resources
▪ Discovered inefficiencies in incident and task reporting and created Power Query programs to
automate the data manipulation
▪ Learned company batch scripting system and created processes for email reporting
▪ Documented projects and trained team members in the use of Python, Excel, and Power Query

positions.title: IT Project and Research Intern
positions.description:
• Created a Java application with the MVC framework for text extraction and indexing of PDF files
• Tested company password security requirements for Microsoft Active Directory with GPU
accelerated hash cracking software
• Wrote Powershell scripts for specific file searches and network administration
• Configured Microsoft Sharepoint 2013 for internal use
• Installed and set up Linux-based kiosk clients for credit union branches using PXE network
boot capabilities
• Researched Hadoop platforms and big data services and created database and
administration servers for testing
• Managed Windows installations, Active Directory settings, and hardware configurations for
employee workstations

honors.title: Summa Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Oklahoma · May 2018

projects.title: CFB Spread Predictor
projects.description: Python application that scrapes the web for college football rankings and statistics, using the data as input to a neural network for predicting spreads

projects.title: RoboQWOP
projects.description:
Python application applying machine learning to teach the runner in the game QWOP how to run.

It uses a program called Simba to execute pascal scripts to track the movement of a runner in the game, then the python app reads this data and uses reinforcement learning to improve the runner's performance.
